purpose: Allow an owner to provide only repository context plus a batch of questions while keeping user-owned facts distinct from agent-owned academic and pedagogical decisions.

learner_knowledge.rule: Ask only about prerequisite or bridge ideas that materially affect X, Y, W, support posture or concept-rebuild routing. Never infer these states from an overall percentage.

source_provenance.rule: Do not invent an exam, book, year, paper or official-answer status.

agent_owned_decisions: learner-relative X after owner knowledge is known
learner bridge Y from DEMONSTRATED evidence
forbidden_clarification_requests: Ask the owner to choose D1-D4.
Ask the owner to choose the cognitive demand.
Ask the owner to choose a QRT template.
Ask the owner to write X, Y, Z or W.
Ask the owner to design the hint ladder, SVG, misconception repair or worked solution.
Ask the owner to provide a learner percentage as a substitute for idea-level knowledge.

clarification_behavior.production_profile_rule: Never fabricate a production learner profile. If knowledge evidence is absent, ask the owner or retain the personalized review as unresolved.
